# Moblicode

> Moblicode builds iOS and Android apps for every App Store and Google Play category — utilities, games, medical, beauty, social — with 19+ years of US-based mobile expertise and end-to-end App Store submission.

## Who we are

Moblicode is a US-based mobile application development studio founded by Daniel Roberts. We have been shipping iOS and Android applications since 2006 — more than 19 years of native mobile work across every category available on the App Store and Google Play.

We are not a generic agency. We are a focused, in-house engineering team that takes mobile applications from concept through App Store submission and approval.

## What we do

- **iOS app development** — native Swift and SwiftUI applications for iPhone and iPad
- **Android app development** — Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, built for the full range of Android phones and tablets
- **App Store submission** — we know what gets approved and what gets rejected; we carry the application through Apple and Google review
- **Middle-tier & APIs** — the server-side database and API layer that makes the mobile app feel instant

## Categories we build for

Every category on the App Store: Business, Books, Catalogs, Developer Tools, Education, Entertainment, Finance, Food & Drink, Games, Graphics & Design, Health & Fitness, Lifestyle, Magazines & Newspapers, Medical, Music, Navigation, News, Photo & Video, Productivity, Reference, Shopping, Social Networking, Sports, Travel, Utilities, and Weather. Plus every Games sub-genre on Google Play.

## Selected work

- **MyTSA** (iOS, U.S. Transportation Security Administration) — 1M+ App Store downloads
- **Launch to Wellness** (iOS) — AI therapy chat with private community forum
- **Gravball HD** (iOS) — original 2.5D color-matching arcade game

## Who we work with

- Startups validating a mobile idea
- Small and medium businesses launching their first or next app
- Individuals with a single concept they want shipped properly
- In-house product teams that need additional mobile capacity

## Why Moblicode

- 19+ years of mobile, with a single point of engineering contact
- US-based, transparent pricing — no offshore handoffs, no opaque rate cards
- Submission is not optional: we carry every build through App Store and Google Play approval
- Every App Store category covered — utilities, games, medical, beauty, social, and beyond
